verdict.rationale: Freshsales documents deletion controls in its API, including a dedicated 'Forget a Contact' endpoint and general API support for deleting account data, so users can programmatically erase records. Nothing in the evidence shows configurable data-retention policies, retention periods, or account-level purge settings, so only the deletion half of the story is covered, and only as endpoint titles. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies/periods, documented scope and semantics of 'forget' (e.g., backups, permanence), admin-level retention or deletion settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.
